nome_jp: 龍脈空船 トンナンシャーペ
testo:
■ Whenever one of your water creatures attacks, your opponent puts the top card of their deck into their graveyard. If it's a spell, you may cast it for no cost. If you do, put it into its owner's graveyard after casting it.
■ Dragsolution: At the start of your turn, if your opponent has 10 or more cards in their graveyard, you may flip this card to the dragheart creature side and untap it.
testo_jp:
■ 自分の水のクリーチャーが攻撃する時、相手の山札の上から1枚目を墓地に置く。それが呪文であれば、自分がコストを支払わずに唱えてもよい。
■ 龍解：自分のターンのはじめに、相手の墓地にカードが10枚以上あれば、このドラグハートをクリーチャー側に裏返し、アンタップしてもよい。
